description: This file defines the OAuthClientSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams and specifies allowed sorting fields for OAuth client search filters. It includes constructor logic to set the default sort field.

classes.name: OAuthClientSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying search filter parameters for OAuth clients, including allowed sort fields and default sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'oauthClient.id'.
